julesThoughtProcess: I chose a bright cerulean blue (#38BDF8) to evoke the glow of sky-simulating municipal panels. It fits the tone of grounded optimism—a vibrant splash of color cutting through the metallic grays of the technofuturistic cityscape.
storyPanel: The municipal sky-panels flickered, casting a cerulean glow over the crowded thoroughfare. Down here, amongst the humming vendor stalls and tangled charging cables, an old maintenance synth and a young human apprentice took a break to share some synthetic tea. The district was loud, cluttered, and worn at the edges, but as they laughed over a shared joke, the synthetic sky didn't matter. The warmth between them was real enough.
